title: The Bianconeri's Redemption
theme: Edik and Del Piero make Juve great again
goal: Restore Juventus to its former glory by winning the Champions League.
prologue: The roar of the crowd is a distant memory, replaced by the murmurs of doubt. Juventus, once the symbol of Italian footballing dominance, now languishes in the shadow of its past glories. A scandal has tarnished its name, and the team's spirit is broken. But whispers of a new dawn echo through the hallowed halls of Continassa. Two legendary figures, Alessandro Del Piero and a rising star named Edik, have returned, tasked with a monumental challenge: to rebuild the Bianconeri from the ashes and reclaim their rightful place at the pinnacle of European football. The stakes are immense — not just for the club, but for the pride of Turin itself.

burnout.description: You pushed too hard in training and have suffered burnout. Your season is over before it truly began.

media_scandal.description: Your poor handling of the press has led to a media scandal, damaging the club's reputation and your own.

media_doubt.description: Your lack of conviction with the media has sown doubt among the fans, affecting team morale beyond repair.
